items.title: Session init banner
items.description: Prints project name, sprint/registry file freshness (>24h stale warning), active work item, and uncommitted-change count at session start. Requires CURRENT_SPRINT.md / COMPONENT_REGISTRY.md (or configured equivalents) to say anything beyond the banner.

items.title: Block duplicate component creation
items.description: Blocks (exit 2) creating a new file under components/|hooks/|utilities/|actions/ paths whose name closely matches an existing entry in COMPONENT_REGISTRY.md. Requires that registry file to exist; a no-op without it.

items.title: Warn about unstaged related files
items.description: On `git commit` commands, checks staged .ts/.tsx files for an unstaged related hook file, or staged schema/model changes without a staged types file, and surfaces findings to Claude via additionalContext. Advisory only — never blocks the commit.

items.title: Suggest a relevant skill from the prompt (map-driven)
items.description: Reads the compiled skill-map artifact (~/.claude/context-manager/skill-map.resolved.json, falling back to skill-map.static.json), ranks topic/stack tag and skill-name matches against the submitted prompt, and surfaces at most one suggested skill to Claude via additionalContext. Requires 2+ distinct matching signals to fire; fails silently (exit 0, no output) if the map is missing or corrupt. Replaces the keyword-grep skill-suggester.sh (retired 2026-08-09) — see CHANGELOG.md.

items.title: Detect skill-refinement opportunities in prompts
items.description: Detects phrasing like "skill doesn't work", "missing trigger", "false positive" and suggests running `/rhize-context-manager:learn-harvest` (then `/skill-refine review`) to queue the signal for triage. Moved here from rhize-devflow 2026-08-09.

items.title: Prompt for refinements after a substantial session
items.description: At session end, computes tool-call count, tool-error count, distinct files written, and session duration from the transcript JSONL; if any threshold is exceeded (>20 tool calls, any error, >60min, >10 files), suggests `/rhize-context-manager:learn-harvest` (then `/skill-refine review`). Moved here from rhize-devflow 2026-08-09.

dependencies.name: @rhize/skill-forge
dependencies.purpose: npm CLI required by /skill-refine's `run` step (`npx @rhize/skill-forge evolve <skill-dir> ...`) and by third-party skill intake (`skill-forge add`).
dependencies.degradedBehavior: There is no evolve/safety-gate mechanism without it — /skill-refine run cannot execute, and new third-party skills have no gate to pass through.

replacement.suggestion: hand-edit SKILL.md files and manually vet third-party skill sources
replacement.warning: skill-forge's SkillOpt gate and safety re-gate are the actual safety mechanism behind auto-promoting a skill edit. Hand-editing without it means shipping unreviewed skill changes — install @rhize/skill-forge rather than skip the gate.

dependencies.name: headroom
dependencies.purpose: CLI required for /learn-harvest's Step 2 (`headroom learn --project <cwd>` dry-run), one of its three refinement-signal sources.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: That step fails outright — the command has no built-in skip for a missing headroom binary; the claude-mem and skill-monitor sources are unaffected but you'd need to run them separately.

replacement.suggestion: manually review transcripts for repeated corrections instead of running headroom learn
replacement.warning: headroom's learn heuristics are maintained upstream and improve independently of this plugin; a manual transcript review is slower and won't stay current with headroom's own pattern detection.

dependencies.name: ecc:harness-audit
dependencies.purpose: Optional deeper final pass /context-doctor chains into after its own layer checks.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: /context-doctor prints 'ecc:harness-audit not available — skipping' and completes with its own checks only — this is the documented, graceful path.

replacement.suggestion: write bespoke harness-audit checks directly into /context-doctor
replacement.warning: ecc's harness-audit already codifies a broad, maintained audit surface; duplicating it here means maintaining a second copy of the same checks that drifts the moment ecc's audit changes.

dependencies.name: claude-mem
dependencies.purpose: Global session memory the context-stack layer routes to; also /learn-harvest's Step 3 signal source (recent correction/friction observations).
dependencies.degradedBehavior: context-stack marks the layer inactive in /context-doctor; /learn-harvest's claude-mem source contributes no entries, leaving headroom-learn + skill-monitor as the only sources.

replacement.suggestion: build a custom cross-session memory store
replacement.warning: claude-mem's memory and search tooling already exist and are maintained upstream; a DIY memory layer means owning storage, retrieval, and dashboard code claude-mem gives you for free.

dependencies.name: OpenWolf
dependencies.purpose: Per-repo file-intel layer (`.wolf/`) the context-stack routing logic coexists with; per-repo opt-in.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: context-stack marks the layer inactive for repos without a .wolf/ directory; no in-session file-intel benefit for those repos, no other effect.

replacement.warning: OpenWolf already tracks and updates its own per-repo index format; a manual index drifts the moment that format changes upstream.

dependencies.name: Serena
dependencies.purpose: Semantic code navigation MCP server the context-stack layer routes symbol-lookup work to.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: context-stack falls back to native grep/read-based navigation for symbol operations; slower on large codebases but functional.

replacement.suggestion: rely on grep/Read for symbol navigation
replacement.warning: this is the plugin's own documented fallback, not a case for a custom reimplementation — Serena's semantic index is the thing being skipped, not something to rebuild by hand.

dependencies.name: CodeGraph
dependencies.purpose: Code-knowledge-graph CLI + MCP (`codegraph` binary, `codegraph init` per repo) the context-stack layer routes to for indexed repos.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: context-stack falls back to grep/Read for repos without a `.codegraph/` index; no other effect.

replacement.suggestion: rely on grep/Read instead of an indexed knowledge graph
replacement.warning: this is the plugin's own documented fallback — CodeGraph indexing is the user's decision to opt into per repo, not something a hand-rolled index should try to replicate.

dependencies.name: Graphiti
dependencies.purpose: Opt-in temporal knowledge-graph memory, adopted via the graphiti-memory skill — explicitly NOT a dependency of anything else in this plugin.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: No effect on any other skill or command — Graphiti is additive, opt-in memory, not something the plugin routes through by default.

replacement.suggestion: skip temporal memory entirely, or use claude-mem's non-temporal memory instead
replacement.warning: if you specifically need temporal/graph-shaped memory, Graphiti is already built and maintained for that; a hand-rolled temporal store is a much larger undertaking than the other replacements on this list.
